_comment: Launch gate for the Sovereign AI Standard, the Tensor site and the companion documents. Every placeholder marker in site/*.html carries data-gate=<id>; standard/check-consistency.py fails on a marker with no gate, an unknown gate, or a gate already marked resolved. Recommendations and reasoning are in standard/launch-gate.md.

gates.title: Effective date
gates.decision: No effective date is stated anywhere.

gates.title: Domains
gates.decision: Standard: sovereignai.org, already used by every address on the site, available at GoDaddy. Tensor: tensordiligence.ai is used for every Tensor address and is not registered; tensordiligence.com is taken by someone else.

gates.title: Administering body
gates.decision: Sovereign Technology Systems Corporation (B Corp certification pending), through its research arm Sovereign AI Lab.

gates.title: Certification mark
gates.decision: SovereignAI, USPTO application Serial No. 99861987. Wording changed from 'registered' to 'registration pending' until the registration issues.

gates.title: Appeal function
gates.note: See launch-gate.md: add at least one member from outside Sovereign Technology Systems Corporation to each appeal panel.

gates.title: Assessor accreditation
gates.note: Proposal in launch-gate.md: granting body, criteria, fees, surveillance, ISO/IEC 17065 timeline.

gates.title: Register opening
gates.note: The register page still shows fictional example rows and the footer still says no certificates have been issued. Either publish real entries or empty the table.

gates.title: EU AI Act citations
gates.note: The compliance attachment referred to in the brief did not arrive. Markers stay until it does.

gates.title: Tensor certification terms
gates.note: Proposal in launch-gate.md: term, notice window, fees, founding cohort.

gates.title: Tensor trust page policies
gates.note: Proposal in launch-gate.md consolidates nine markers into four published policies.

gates.title: Versioning
gates.decision: Standard v1.0 (draft), August 2026, on every document. The Hallmark keeps Rev D and the V-Seal guide keeps Rev 1 as document revisions against that Standard version.

gates.title: Patent reference
gates.note: U.S. application 19/418,922 could not be verified online; applications are unpublished for eighteen months. Confirm the number against the filing receipt.

gates.title: Track B consultation questions
gates.note: Consultation questions published with the draft on purpose. They close when v1.0 is finalised, not at launch.
